displayName: Pumpkin Rouge Vif D'Etampes Film Coated Treated
notes: Film coated, Thiram treated. Flat cheese-wheel shape, 12-18 lb fruit. Moderately sweet, good for pies. Packed for 2025.
harvestIndicators: Rind hard and firm; mature color (changed from green)
Harvest late September to October, before a heavy frost
Cut from the vine leaving 3 to 4 in of stem; avoid bruising

sprayWindows.title: POST grass window (Clethodim)
sprayWindows.body: For grass escapes in the cucurbit block. Verify sprayer never carried auxin without decon.
